notes.title: NINDO release
notes.notes:
We have now officially released the game on NINDO!
Thank you to all players who have played since the early access period,
to all Steam users who have added the game to their wishlist,
to everyone who has visited the NINDO store page at least once!
This game has a unique idea and is very easy and quick to play.
Why not practice your ninjutsu skills to warm up your fingers or kill time while you're waiting?

notes.title: Ver 0.2.14
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.

-Fixed a bug where purchase history was not recorded in the inventory.

Function changes

-Added sound effects when inventory purchase is successful, purchase is unsuccessful, and when changing items.

notes.title: Ver 0.2.13
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
- A bug that allowed players to purchase items even when they did not have enough money in their inventory.
The following game balance adjustments have been made.
- Entering an incorrect seal will now result in a 20 point deduction.
This will increase the value of entering seals accurately.

notes.title: Ver 0.2.12
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
- Fixed a bug where purchased items would not be displayed when the inventory was opened.
- Fixed ranking strings in the DATA tab to be displayed on separate lines to avoid duplication.

notes.title: Ver 0.2.11
notes.notes:
An achievement feature has been implemented.
- Achievements will be unlocked based on the score you obtain.
- Please look forward to further expansions!

notes.title: Ver 0.2.10
notes.notes:
DATA screen
-You can now send your high scores to the leaderboard
Let's play NINDO together and train our minds!

notes.title: Ver 0.2.9
notes.notes:
INVENTORY screen
- You can now purchase costumes using your money
- Money will be accumulated based on 10% of your high score during gameplay

notes.title: Ver 0.2.8
notes.notes: In version 0.2.7, we fixed a display error caused by an internal system bug that supports multiple languages.

notes.title: Ver 0.2.7
notes.notes:
DATA SCREEN
-You can now record your money and high score.
-10% of your score is added to your money, which can later be used to expand content in INVENTORY.
SETTING SCREEN
-Multilingual support has been expanded.

notes.title: Ver 0.2.6
notes.notes:
Added the basics of the screen design.
- Added only the foundation for the INVENTORY page.
- Added only the foundation for the DATA page.
- Adjusted the layout of the settings screen.
* We've secretly fixed the spelling mistake in INVENTRY! This update will not affect any previous versions you've played from!

notes.title: Ver 0.2.5
notes.notes:
*Language settings set from version 0.2.3 onwards will be reset.
- Updated internal structure to support multiple languages.

notes.title: Ver 0.2.4
notes.notes: The main menu screen has been made a little more stylish.

notes.title: Ver 0.2.3
notes.notes:
This is the first update for the early access version.
- You can now adjust the volume on the SETTINGS screen.
- You can now set the language on the SETTINGS screen.
The x button on the top right is the cancel button, and the button to the left of it is the save button.
